sub_indicators.label: Population register
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.registry
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy puts an electronic population register first among the base registers, continuously updated from civil registration.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no population register exists.
A population register is being built, procured or provided for in a new law.
A population register, or a national ID register serving as one, is in service.
Births or deaths registered are entered in the population register.
Other registers or services take people's records from the population register.

gaps.4: No source found since October 2023 says other systems take records from the population register.
gaps.3: No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the population register.
gaps.2: No source found since October 2023 says: is a population register in service.
gaps.1: No source found since October 2023 says: is a population register under way.

ladder.empty: Nothing found names a population register, or says there is none.
ladder.unplaced: Nothing found since October 2023 says whether a population register is under way or in service.
